race.comment: IN A TIZZY (8) earns top billing after resuming with a controlled maiden win at Cranbourne, where she was odds-on and put She's Loaded away by a length and a half. She looks the runner with the most upside and will be very hard to catch again. BEFUDDLE (2) brings the strongest exposed grade reference, having resumed with a FM BM70 win at Seymour over this trip, beating a very much in-form Tsarine. She can go right on with it. KIPPIS (3) comes back from Saturday company and BM78 grade, with her Bendigo win two back reading well for this. Can atone. BARDIA'S DREAM (5) can mix form a bit but was close up when last seen at Bendigo and a repeat of that goes close.
